title: Your GTA 6 box has NO disc inside
description: The GTA 6 physical edition only contains a download code. Here's what's true, what's rumor and what's fake.

lines.text: Your GTA 6 box? There's no disc inside.
lines.headline: NO DISC

lines.text: It's confirmed. The box only has a download code.
lines.headline: JUST A CODE

lines.text: You'll still need up to 212 gigs free on your console.
lines.headline: 212 GB

lines.text: And some players reportedly got boxes with missing or already used codes.
Does the box let you play early? No. That's false.
A disc version coming later? Also false. There's still no disc version.
It unlocks the night of November 18th to 19th, depending on where you live.
lines.headline: NOV 18-19

lines.text: Got the box? Keep your receipt. And follow for confirmed GTA 6 news.
lines.headline: KEEP YOUR RECEIPT
